title: To designate the Federal building located at 2030 Southwest 145th Avenue in Miramar, Florida, as the "Benjamin P. Grogan and Jerry L. Dove Federal Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on March 24, 2015. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the federal building located at 2030 Southwest 145th Avenue in Miramar, Florida, as the "Benjamin P. Grogan and Jerry L. Dove Federal Building."

summary.headline: A 2015 law names a federal building in Miramar, Florida, after two people, Benjamin P. Grogan and Jerry L. Dove.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a federal building at 2030 Southwest 145th Avenue in Miramar, Florida, a new official name: the "Benjamin P. Grogan and Jerry L. Dove Federal Building." It only changes the name. It does not change how the building is run, who uses it, or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on April 7, 2015.
